description: Update a todo's title, description, priority, status, assignee, or due date. Use when scope changes, ownership shifts, or you move it between kanban columns ('open', 'in_progress', 'done', 'dropped'). agent_id required for attribution.

agent_id.description: Stable identifier for the calling agent.

due_at.description: Optional due date in ISO format. A date-only value like 2026-06-15 means due by the end of that day. Pass empty string to clear.

todo_id.description: UUID of the todo to update

name: update_todo
title: Update a Boardroom todo
